research_scope: DLC Parallel Quest skills from PQ101-110 selected after screening against the canonical skill index and prior research batches. Non-skill rewards were excluded.

verification_audit.method: Skill identity, class, core cost data, DLC association, and PQ acquisition routes were reconciled against current Xenoverse 2 skill references and independent quest documentation. Drop probabilities and disputed Ultimate Finish requirements were not inferred.
verification_audit.accuracy_note: The earlier batch record for Breaker Energy Wave had an incorrect source-character/cost combination and has been corrected to the documented Goku source and 0 Ki. Divinity Unleashed was previously marked as Ultimate-Finish-required without sufficient evidence; that field is now null. Super Black Kamehameha Rosé also remains null because available community evidence conflicts on whether the Ultimate Finish itself is mandatory.

records.name: Breaker Energy Wave
records.character_source: Goku - Turtle Hermit Gi (Go) 4; Goku (Super Saiyan God) Customize Partner; Goku (Super Saiyan 4) Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 101 - Seeking Fighters for Tournament; Ultimate Finish reward
records.skill_description: A powerful beam Ultimate that can only be used once when the opponent is near defeat.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill documentation identifies Breaker Energy Wave as a 0-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate available to CaCs. The skill is specifically associated with PQ101 and the available GameFAQs evidence reports an Ultimate Finish as the unlock requirement.
records.combo_notes: Its low-health one-use restriction makes it a finishing tool rather than a conventional freely available Ultimate.
records.pve_notes: Best treated as a finisher because the skill is constrained by the opponent's remaining health.
records.pvp_notes: The low-health restriction is the defining limitation; exact damage scaling is not asserted.

records.name: Sonic Bomb
records.character_source: Frieza (1st Form) Customize Partner; Omega Shenron Customize Partner; Super Baby 2 Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 105 - Champa's Hellish Holiday; reward
records.skill_description: Generate an explosion at the opponent's location and shift the explosion center with directional input.
records.mechanics_notes: Current documentation identifies Sonic Bomb as a 100-Ki Strike Super with controllable long-range explosion placement. PQ105 reward documentation lists it among the skill rewards but does not establish a mandatory Ultimate Finish requirement.
records.combo_notes: The controllable explosion provides utility at ranges where a conventional Strike Super would not normally reach.
records.pve_notes: Useful for catching moving AI targets and adjusting the explosion center.
records.pvp_notes: The ability to shift the explosion center is the defining spacing property; exact frame data remains unresolved.

records.name: God of Destruction's Roar
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 105 - Champa's Hellish Holiday; reward
records.skill_description: A sustained shout that forces the opponent to guard and rapidly drains Stamina while maintained.
records.mechanics_notes: Current documentation classifies the skill as a 100-Ki Strike Super. It deals no direct damage while rapidly reducing the opponent's Stamina; holding it too long leaves the user vulnerable.
records.combo_notes: Primarily pressure and Stamina-management utility rather than direct damage.
records.pve_notes: Can pressure guarding AI and create a potential guard-break condition when Stamina is exhausted.
records.pvp_notes: Duration control is important because the user becomes vulnerable after shouting too long.

records.name: Super Black Kamehameha Rosé
records.character_source: Rosé Goku Black - Gi 1, 2 & Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 109 - A Fateful Fight with a Deity; skill reward
records.skill_description: A potent punch followed by a pink Kamehameha beam combining Saiyan and divine power.
records.mechanics_notes: Current documentation identifies a 500-Ki, 25-hit Ki Blast Ultimate. Community evidence conflicts on whether the Ultimate Finish itself is mandatory, so the requirement is intentionally unresolved rather than inferred.
records.combo_notes: The initial punch transitions into the beam and distinguishes this skill from the ordinary Super Black Kamehameha.
records.pve_notes: The combined rush-and-beam sequence can connect from suitable openings.
records.pvp_notes: The initial hit and beam timing are important; exact frame behavior is version-sensitive.

records.name: Divinity Unleashed
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 110 - Heretics from a Dark World; reward
records.skill_description: A god-ki power-up skill that supports Ki recovery after activation.
records.mechanics_notes: Current PQ110 documentation identifies Divinity Unleashed as a skill reward and reports it in a reward slot rather than explicitly as an Ultimate-Finish-only skill. Exact charge timing, recovery values, and version-specific mechanics are not asserted here.
records.combo_notes: Resource-management Power Up rather than direct damage.
records.pve_notes: Useful for builds relying on repeated Ki-based attacks.
records.pvp_notes: Activation timing matters because the charge/action can be interrupted by pressure.
